title: Finite exchange rectangle for intrinsic coefficient reduction
statement: For an adic coefficient datum d, a chosen cartesian square sq, K in D(A_X), and n, the following rectangle commutes: finite pullback of the canonical finite projection map followed by finite exchange equals χ_g followed by reduction of integral exchange followed by the finite projection map for f′ and finite pushforward of χ_g′ inverse. The projection maps are the specified adjuncts [def-weil-pbc-four-corners], and exchange is the ambient mate [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange]. There are no properness or finiteness assumptions on K.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteReductionExchange_rectangle
    (sq : ChosenCartesianSquare g' f' f g) (K : d.derived X) (n : ℕ) :
    (d.finitePull g n).map (d.finiteProjection f K n) ≫
        (d.finiteExchange sq n).app ((d.reduction X n).obj K) =
      (d.chi g n).hom.app ((d.push f).obj K) ≫
        (d.reduction Y' n).map ((d.integralExchange sq).app K) ≫
        d.finiteProjection f' ((d.pull g').obj K) n ≫
        (d.finitePush f' n).map ((d.chi g' n).inv.app K)
